name: @aiti-ai/aiti-debug-inject
description: Minimal remote-debug injection — injects another pi-web instance's debugger into this instance's pages; the service URL is a text feature in extman, off by default

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 极简远程调试注入 —— 把另一个 pi-web 实例的调试器注入本实例页面，服务地址是 extman 里的文本 feature，默认关闭

soul: 调试器该穿在哪件衣服里，由你说了算。

soulI18n.en: Which outfit the debugger wears is up to you.
